batch: 2 (chs 4-11, the siege signs, temple abominations, the departing glory, the heart of flesh)

units.characteristics: the prophet's body made a sign; un-pitying justice; God broken over the whoring heart
units.gist: the sign-acts - Ezekiel BOUND with cords, lying on his side, eating siege-rations: his BODY made a message of the siege; 'my EYE WILL NOT SPARE, nor will I have pity' (God's un-pitying justice against the abominations); yet the grief beneath - 'how I HAVE BEEN BROKEN over their WHORING HEART that has departed from me, and over their eyes that go whoring after their idols' - severity that is itself a wounded love

units.characteristics: the hidden idolatry that thinks God unseeing; the mark on those who sigh and groan
units.gist: GEM - the temple-abominations vision: idols engraved on the walls, 'the elders IN THE DARK, each in his ROOM OF PICTURES, for they say, THE LORD DOES NOT SEE US, the LORD has forsaken the land' (practical atheism, the heart's secret idols); the 25 with backs to the temple; then the MARK set 'on the foreheads of those who SIGH AND GROAN over all the abominations' (the grieving remnant spared); 'begin at my sanctuary'; Ezekiel's intercession 'will you destroy all the remnant?'

units.characteristics: the glory withdrawing; God a sanctuary in exile; the heart of stone replaced by a heart of flesh
units.gist: GEM - the GLORY OF THE LORD departing by stages (from the cherub to the threshold to the east gate to the mountain east of the city) - God's presence withdrawn by persistent defilement; yet 'I HAVE BEEN A SANCTUARY TO THEM for a while in the countries where they have gone' (God himself a sanctuary in exile); and the promise - 'I will give them ONE HEART, and a NEW SPIRIT... I will REMOVE THE HEART OF STONE from their flesh and give them A HEART OF FLESH'
